note: Say what a generated screen does away from its drawn width and let the caller decide it: TSX exports carry `widthBehavior` (static per-node findings with candidates; nothing rendered) and `verificationScope` while the default TSX stays byte-identical, and the opt-in `widthPolicy` (`root: fluid` plus per-node anchors) writes anchors, stretched edges, centred offsets, rule masks that follow their box and shape sizes, verified at the drawn width. `devup_ui_validate` names the element and attribute of each violation, joins violations to the export's sourceMap (`sourceMapLink`, sourceMap entries now carry `elementIndex`) and reports `layoutRisks` and `verificationScope` without changing `ok`, `okReason` or strict. Artifact misses name `issued-by-another-process` and carry a `recovery` mode, capability refusals name what is missing with a `nextAction`, and `cache.reuse` lists what an artifactId can still project. New tool `devup_runtime_audit` writes a declarative multi-viewport browser plan and ingests the report the consumer-side executor in `harness/runtime-audit` writes, rejecting reports not bound to the plan and recounting every item; the server never launches a browser or runs a command.
